review.proofing.spelling.note: U:slate/spelling: opens the Spelling pane (F7) on the first misspelt word of the page at or after the caret and selects it: Ignore, Ignore All, Add (to the dictionary), the suggestions, Change and Change All. The misspelt words of the page are squiggled and the right-click menu on one offers its suggestions, Ignore All and Add to Dictionary. Words are checked against the bundled US English dictionary (nspell over dictionary-en, core/common/lib/spelling.mjs); text marked Do not check spelling, in another language, or in a link is left out. Not checked against upstream (there is none).
